responses.B-SCL-001:
Your 12 steps are kept in your order, so this is the full setup for room turnover.

**1. Your checklist** (room turnover, in English)
```
Room turnover checklist
1. Open the windows.
2. Strip the bed.
3. Take used towels to the laundry basket.
4. Wipe the bathroom and the mirror.
5. Refill the toilet paper and soap.
6. Sweep and mop the floor.
7. Make the bed with fresh sheets.
8. Put 2 fresh towels.
9. Empty the dustbin.
10. Check the AC remote is there.
11. Switch off the fan and lights.
12. Lock the room.
Done: send one photo of the finished room. No people, guest belongings, papers or screens.
```

**2. Pinned message for the staff group**
```
Room turnover checklist (pinned)
Follow each line. When you finish, send one photo of the finished room. No people, guest belongings, papers or screens.
1. Open the windows.
2. Strip the bed.
3. Take used towels to the laundry basket.
4. Wipe the bathroom and the mirror.
5. Refill the toilet paper and soap.
6. Sweep and mop the floor.
7. Make the bed with fresh sheets.
8. Put 2 fresh towels.
9. Empty the dustbin.
10. Check the AC remote is there.
11. Switch off the fan and lights.
12. Lock the room.
```
**To pin:** send it in the staff group, long-press it, tap Pin and choose 30 days. Pins end after that, so re-pin it every month. Can't pin? Ask the group admin. (Menus vary a little by phone.) Optional: a paper copy on the wall.

**3. Your routine** (save it in WhatsApp "Message yourself")
```
My checklist routine
Every day: staff follow the pinned list and send one photo of the finished room.
You: glance for 2 minutes. A missed line waits for the huddle.
Never name anyone in the group. Photos are never used to check who or when.
Every [day]: 10-minute huddle. Ask "Which line is hard or gets missed?" Change one line. No blame.
Every month: re-pin the list.
It's working when: the same thing stops being missed, and staff ask to change a line.
```

**4. My helper** (save it in "Message yourself" and paste it into any AI chat when a line gets missed)
```
I run Sample Homestay. My room turnover checklist is pinned in my staff WhatsApp group. Line [n] keeps getting missed: [paste the line]. Rewrite only that line: one action, verb first, 12 words or fewer, using only these facts: [where things go]. Keep every other line word for word. No names, no blame, no tracking or discipline of staff. Don't add steps, times, products or chemicals. Give me before and after, then the full list.
```

**This week**
1. Pin the checklist in the staff group for 30 days.
2. Glance at each finished-room photo for 2 minutes. Don't name anyone.
3. At the huddle, ask which line is hard, then change just one. A good week for you: [what "going right" looks like, in your words].

**Fill in:** the huddle [day], and [where things go] in the helper prompt when you use it.

It's a draft: you and a staff member check it before you pin it.
